name: Wizard
description: A master of arcane knowledge who studies magic, discovers secrets, and shapes reality through spells.

features.name: Spellbook
features.description: A collection of discovered spells the wizard can prepare and expand through research.

features.name: Cantrips
features.description: Simple spells the wizard can cast without consuming spell resources.

features.name: Ritual Casting
features.description: Allows the wizard to cast certain spells as rituals without using spell slots.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.description: A specialized magical path that defines the wizard's unique studies.

features.name: Spellcrafting
features.description: Modify and create spells through research, ingredients, and magical experimentation.
